results.answer: Whether you can get a refund depends on the effective date of your plan's policy. Under the 2025 billing policy, annual plans can only be refunded if the request is made within 30 days of the purchase or renewal date, meaning a request at 45 days would not be refundable. However, under the 2026 billing policy (effective 1 March 2026), annual plans can be refunded on a pro-rated basis if the request is made within 60 days of the purchase or renewal date, which would allow a refund at 45 days.
